implementation: Root-owned platform email/SMS credentials are hidden from client table access and resolved only through fixed trusted bindings.
BYOC credentials support owner/delegate write-only secret updates with scoped operation use.
Authentication delivery uses fixed server-selected identity, recipient, and credential binding; challenge payloads remain encrypted and atomically queued.

User-created credential operations require current operation permission and credential scope before privileged secret loading; creatorless tenant operations fail closed while root-owned trusted operations remain supported.

Credential ownership, delegation, redaction, fixed platform binding, BYOC, unauthorized use, and pre-load permission guards passed; credential probe reported 1935ms.
Runtime recovery, operation lifecycle, authentication, effects, webhooks, readiness, and context-race checks passed.

Live provider delivery and production deployment remain unverified.
